description: Deterministic edit: permanently delete one or more named layers of a project, committed immediately. close_gap: true ripples the timeline closed and works with a single layer_id only. Selectors such as "all" or "@…" are refused, and so is a delete that would leave the project empty. To hide a layer temporarily use update_layer with {"visible": false} instead.

close_gap.description: Ripple later layers left to close the gap (single layer_id only).

layer_ids.description: Several layers to delete (alternative to layer_id).

project_id.description: Project whose committed scene is edited.

name: delete_layer
title: Delete layer
